dct_description_sm: Meteorological data recorded by Environment Canada AAVOS system during the CCGS Amundsen scientific expeditions constitute ancillary data for all other data recorded during the expeditions by providing the prevailing atmospheric conditions in which biological, chemical and physical samplings were conducted
dct_title_s: 2013-2015 AAVOS Meteorological Data in Canadian, Greenlandic and USA Arctic Seas recorded onboard CCGS Amundsen
